description: Exact formulas of the Revision field theory (SPEC sections 1-4, 6) for the author's primordial metric with b4(x4) (general a4 and b4), for the documents. Every formula is verified by a named check of Revision/theory/reports/wolfram-field-theory.json. Wolfram InputForm; g[xa] = gamma^(xa) of Revision/algebra/gammas.json; a4' = Derivative[1][a4][x4]; b4' = Derivative[1][b4][x4]; z = 6 H x0; Psibar = Psi^dagger C; S = Psibar Psi; V = m + U'(S); both statistics unless stated.

formulas.description: nonzero Christoffel symbols {l, m, n, Gamma^l_mn} (m <= n; Gamma^l_nm = Gamma^l_mn), Wolfram positions 1..8 = x0..x7
nonzero R^mu_nu as {mu, nu, value}, Wolfram positions 1..8 = x0..x7
Ricci scalar R
formulas.wl: 6*(-7*H^2 + Derivative[1][a4][x4]^2) - (3*Derivative[1][a4][x4]*Derivative[1][b4][x4])/b4[x4] + (3*Derivative[2][b4][x4])/b4[x4]

formulas.description: nonzero omega_mu,ab = eta_ac omega_mu^c_b as {mu, a, b, value} with a < b (omega_mu,ba = -omega_mu,ab); Wolfram positions mu, a, b = 1..8 = x0..x7
the spinor connection Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu,ab S^ab
formulas.wl: Omega_xi = (1/2) E^a4[x4] Sin[6 H x0]^(1/6) (a4'[x4] g[xi].g[x4] + H g[xi].g[x0]) (i = 1, 2, 3); Omega_xt = -(1/2) E^-a4[x4] b4[x4]^(1/2) Sin[6 H x0]^(1/6) ((a4'[x4] - b4'[x4]/(2 b4[x4])) g[x4].g[xt] + H g[xt].g[x0]) (t = 5, 6, 7); Omega_x0 = Omega_x4 = 0; g[xa] = gamma^(xa) (frame gammas of the fixture)

formulas.description: the matrices gamma^mu Omega_mu (no sum) for mu = x0..x7 as coefficients of gamma^(x4) and gamma^(x0): {mu (Wolfram position 1..8 = x0..x7), coefficient of gamma^(x4), coefficient of gamma^(x0)}
gamma^mu Omega_mu (sum over mu); gamma[xa] = gamma^(xa)
formulas.wl: 3*H*gamma["x0"] + (3*gamma["x4"]*Derivative[1][b4][x4])/(4*b4[x4])

formulas.description: Lagrangian density for both statistics (SPEC section 3), Psibar = Psi^dagger C, S = Psibar Psi, sqrt g = b4^(3/2) Cos[z]
formulas.wl: L = b4[x4]^(3/2) Cos[z] [ (1/2) sum_mu (Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu Psi) - m S - U(S) ] = b4[x4]^(3/2) Cos[z] [ (1/2) sum_a (1/f_a) (Psibar gamma^(a) d_a Psi - d_a Psibar gamma^(a) Psi) - m S - U(S) ]; f_0 = Cot[z], f_(1,2,3) = E^a4 Sin[z]^(1/6), f_4 = 1, f_(5,6,7) = E^-a4 b4^(1/2) Sin[z]^(1/6)

formulas.description: the Euler-Lagrange equation (both statistics), z = 6 H x0, V = m + U'(S)
the adjoint equation (both statistics); for this metric D_mu Psibar = d_mu Psibar - Psibar Omega_mu
formulas.wl: Tan[z] d0 Psibar g[x0] + E^-a4 Sin[z]^(-1/6) (d1 Psibar g[x1] + d2 Psibar g[x2] + d3 Psibar g[x3]) + d4 Psibar g[x4] + E^a4 b4^(-1/2) Sin[z]^(-1/6) (d5 Psibar g[x5] + d6 Psibar g[x6] + d7 Psibar g[x7]) + 3 H Psibar g[x0] + (3/4) (b4'/b4) Psibar g[x4] = -(m + U'(S)) Psibar

formulas.description: the 16 component equations (gamma^mu D_mu Psi)_A = V Psi_A, A = 1..16 (rows of the fixture gammas), V = m + U'(S); dd[xa, Psi[B]] = d Psi_B / d xa

block form: Psi = (psi_minus (rows 1..8, Gamma = -1), psi_plus (rows 9..16, Gamma = +1)); gamma^(xa) = {{0, tb[xa]}, {t[xa], 0}}; equations sum_a (1/f_a) tb[xa] d_a psi_plus + 3 H tb[x0] psi_plus + (3/4)(b4'/b4) tb[x4] psi_plus = V psi_minus and sum_a (1/f_a) t[xa] d_a psi_minus + 3 H t[x0] psi_minus + (3/4)(b4'/b4) t[x4] psi_minus = V psi_plus; listed {xa, tb, t}
first-order evolution form (both statistics)
formulas.wl: d4 Psi = -g[x4] ((m + U'(S)) Psi - sum_(a != x4) (1/f_a) g[xa] d_a Psi - 3 H g[x0] Psi) - (3/4) (b4'[x4]/b4[x4]) Psi

formulas.description: conserved current and its identity (both statistics)
formulas.wl: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi; d_mu (b4[x4]^(3/2) Cos[z] J^mu) = -i b4[x4]^(3/2) Cos[z] (Ebar Psi + Psibar E); J^x4 = Psi^dagger B Psi; Q = Integral b4[x4]^(3/2) Cos[z] Psi^dagger B Psi dx0 dx1 dx2 dx3 dx5 dx6 dx7

formulas.description: second-order identity (both statistics)
formulas.wl: (gamma^mu D_mu)^2 Psi = g^mu,nu (D_mu D_nu - Gamma^l_mu,nu D_l) Psi - (R/4) Psi, R = 6 (a4'[x4]^2 - 7 H^2) - 3 a4'[x4] b4'[x4]/b4[x4] + 3 b4''[x4]/b4[x4]

formulas.description: conservation of a diagonal T = diag(p0, p3, p3, p3, -rho, pt, pt, pt) (order x0..x7) whose entries are functions of x4 and x0 (check energy_exchange_equation); entry 1: {nabla_mu T^mu_nu, nu = x0..x7} (complete identity); entry 2: the equations equivalent to nabla_mu T^mu_nu = 0; entry 3: the same for x0-independent entries (rho, p3, pt, p0 functions of x4 only)

NON-TRIVIALITY [1] (dirac16complex) and [2] (dirac16complex00): exact content of checks nontriviality_1_dirac16complex, nontriviality_2_dirac16complex00, gammaOmega_per_direction, Omega_vanishes_iff_a4prime_b4prime_and_H_vanish, never_flat_for_H_positive, spin_curvature_equals_Riemann
formulas.wl: gamma^mu D_mu Psi - gamma^mu d_mu Psi = gamma^mu Omega_mu Psi = (3 H gamma^(x0) + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4)) Psi (nonzero for every H > 0, all a4 and b4; (3 H gamma^(x0) + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4))^2 = 9 H^2 - (9/16)(b4'/b4)^2); per direction gamma^(xi) Omega_xi = (a4'/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x0) (i = 1, 2, 3, inflating) and gamma^(xt) Omega_xt = (-a4'/2 + b4'/(4 b4)) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) gamma^(x0) (t = 5, 6, 7, deflating): the a4' terms of the time direction cancel, the b4' terms add to (3/4) b4'/b4, the hidden-direction terms add (6 H/2 = 3 H); Omega_mu = 0 for all mu iff a4' = 0, b4' = 0 and H = 0 (H = 0 is a degenerate limit of the metric); [D_mu, D_nu] = (1/2) R_ab,mu,nu S^ab, and R^x0_x0 = -6 H^2 != 0: no frame removes Omega, the metric is never flat for H > 0

formulas.description: the notebook's Majorana-type Lagrangian with real components (checks Majorana_Lg_total_derivative_grassmann, Majorana_Lg_commuting_control)
formulas.wl: anticommuting real Psi: sqrt g Psi^T C gamma^mu D_mu Psi = d_mu ((1/2) sqrt g Psi^T C gamma^mu Psi) (a total derivative; no field equation; Psi^T C Psi = 0); commuting real Phi: Euler-Lagrange expression 2 sqrt g C gamma^mu D_mu Phi and Phi^T C gamma^mu Phi = 0

formulas.description: pressures and equations of state from the diagonal components (SPEC section 4)
formulas.wl: rho = -T^x4_x4, p3 = T^x1_x1, p_t = T^x5_x5, p0 = T^x0_x0; w3 = p3/rho, w_t = p_t/rho, w0 = p0/rho; homogeneous on shell: w3 = w_t = w0 = (S U' - U)/(m S + U)

formulas.description: role of the spin-connection term in the quantum theory (check good_sector_hermiticity_curved)
formulas.wl: Cos[z] [p (Tan[z] d0 + 3 H) q + ((Tan[z] d0 + 3 H) p) q] = d0 (Sin[z] p q): the operator Tan[z] d0 + 3 H is antisymmetric for the measure Cos[z] dx0 up to the boundary term Sin[z] p q, which does not vanish at z = Pi/2; without 3 H the mode operator is not formally Hermitian for this measure and these variables (Psi = Sin[z]^(-1/2) chi with the measure dy needs no such term)

formulas.description: the author's metric with b4 (SPEC section 1; the change of 2026-10-14), coordinates x0..x7
f_a in e^a_mu = f_a delta^a_mu, a = x0..x7
sqrt|det g|
frame metric eta_ab, order x0..x7
energy-momentum tensor from the vielbein variation (both statistics), T^nu_mu = e^b_mu (1/sqrt g) dS/de^b_nu, L0 = L/sqrt g
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/2) (Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi) - (1/4) g_mu,rho nabla_l (Psibar {gamma^l, Sigma^(nu rho)} Psi), Sigma^(nu rho) = (1/4) [gamma^nu, gamma^rho]

formulas.description: symmetric (Belinfante) energy-momentum tensor = symmetric part of the variation tensor = the variation tensor on shell
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu L0 - (1/4) (Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi + Psibar gamma_mu D^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma_mu Psi)

formulas.description: diagonal components (no sum), both statistics; K_mu = kinetic term of direction mu
formulas.wl: K_mu = (1/(2 f_mu)) (Psibar gamma^(mu) d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^(mu) Psi); L0 = sum_mu K_mu - m S - U(S); T^mu_mu = L0 - K_mu; rho = -T^x4_x4 = -sum_(mu != x4) K_mu + m S + U; p3 = T^x1_x1 (= T^x2_x2 = T^x3_x3 for isotropic states) = sum_(mu != x1) K_mu - m S - U; p_t = T^x5_x5 = sum_(mu != x5) K_mu - m S - U; p0 = T^x0_x0 = sum_(mu != x0) K_mu - m S - U

formulas.description: split into kinetic (derivative) and potential parts
formulas.wl: T^nu_mu = T_kin^nu_mu + T_pot^nu_mu, T_pot^nu_mu = -delta^nu_mu (m S + U(S)), T_kin^nu_mu = delta^nu_mu sum_l K_l - (1/4)(Psibar gamma^nu D_mu Psi - D_mu Psibar gamma^nu Psi + Psibar gamma_mu D^nu Psi - D^nu Psibar gamma_mu Psi); potential energy density rho_pot = m S + U, potential pressure p_pot = -(m S + U) in every direction

formulas.description: trace
formulas.wl: T^mu_mu (sum) = 8 L0 - sum_mu K_mu = 7 sum_mu K_mu - 8 (m S + U); on shell = 7 (m + U') S - 8 (m S + U) = -m S + 7 S U' - 8 U

formulas.description: homogeneous states (Psi depends on x4 only): K_mu = 0 for mu != x4 and K_x4 = (m + U') S on shell (the b4' terms of Psi and Psibar cancel in K_x4)
formulas.wl: rho = m S + U(S); p3 = p_t = p0 = S U'(S) - U(S); w = (S U' - U)/(m S + U); for U = (lam/2) S^2: rho = m S + lam S^2/2, p = lam S^2/2, w = lam S/(2 m + lam S); S = b4^(-3/2) S_chi with S_chi constant on shell (check exact_solution_nonlinear_homogeneous_C)

formulas.description: the x4-x0 component of the symmetric tensor (Omega_x0 = Omega_x4 = 0)
formulas.wl: T^x4_x0 = -(1/4) (B40 - Cot[z] B04), B40 = Psibar gamma^(x4) d0 Psi - d0 Psibar gamma^(x4) Psi, B04 = Psibar gamma^(x0) d4 Psi - d4 Psibar gamma^(x0) Psi; T^x0_x4 = -Tan[z]^2 T^x4_x0 (T_x4x0 = T_x0x4)

formulas.description: exact solutions used as test points (checks exact_solution_*), general a4 and b4
formulas.wl: (i) U = 0: Psi = b4^(-3/4) Sin[z]^al (Cosh[k x4] + Sinh[k x4]/k M) chi, M = -m g[x4] + 3 H (2 al + 1) g[x4].g[x0], k^2 = 9 H^2 (2 al + 1)^2 - m^2 (any a4, b4); (ii) U = (lam/2) S^2, homogeneous, commuting: Psi = b4^(-3/4) chi for every solution of chi' = (-(m + lam b4^(-3/2) S0) g[x4] + 3 H g[x4].g[x0]) chi, S0 = chi^dagger C chi constant, S = b4^(-3/2) S0; Grassmann: Psi = b4^(-3/4) sum_k [P c_k + lam S0 eta_k] theta_k, eta_k = -P (A0 I0 + Ac Ic + As Is) c_k, S0 = sum_kl thetabar_k theta_l c_k^dagger C c_l; at (ii): rho = m S + lam S^2/2, p3 = p_t = p0 = lam S^2/2, S = b4^(-3/2) S0

formulas.description: canonical quantisation of dirac16complex (SPEC section 6), x4 the evolution time, sqrt g = b4^(3/2) Cos[z]
formulas.wl: pi_A = (i/2) b4^(3/2) Cos[z] (Psi^dagger B)_A; K = b4^(3/2) Cos[z] C gamma^(x4) = i b4^(3/2) Cos[z] B; {Psi_A(x), Psi^dagger_C(y)}_(x4 = y4) = B_AC delta^7(x - y)/(b4^(3/2) Cos[z]); B = -i C gamma^(x4), B^dagger = B, B^2 = 1, signature (8,8); no positive inner product with Psi^dagger the adjoint (Krein space, fundamental symmetry B); positive representation chi = Psi^dagger B, {Psi_A, chi_C} = delta_AC; Heisenberg: d4 Psi = -i B (1/sqrt g) dHd/dPsi^dagger = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U') Psi - sum_(a != x4) gamma^a D_a Psi]; mode operator h = m (-i g[x4]) + sum_(a != x4) (1/f_a) i g[x4].g[xa] d_a + 3 i H g[x4].g[x0] - i (3/4)(b4'/b4); good sector (no x5, x6, x7 dependence): integral b4^(3/2) Cos[z] u^dagger v d^7x conserved up to boundary terms (h formally Hermitian for chi = b4^(3/4) Psi and the measure Cos[z]), positive Fock space, normal-ordered H = sum E (b^* b + d^* d) >= 0 per momentum; expectation-value rule <Psi^dagger M Psi> = u^dagger B M u (u^dagger u = 1, positive-energy good-sector u); EMT operator T^mu_nu = :T^mu_nu[Psi, Psi^dagger = chi B]: (normal ordered), <T> by the same rule; extra-time modes: E^2 = m^2 + k_s^2 - k_t^2 < 0 for k_t^2 > m^2 + k_s^2, growing as exp(|E| x4)
